Move your cursor over the card — in the app, this is your gyroscope.

15 games. One collection.

Dragon Ball Fusion World Pokémon One Piece Digimon Yu-Gi-Oh! Disney Lorcana Magic: The Gathering Riftbound Final Fantasy TCG Flesh and Blood Gundam Card Game Cyberpunk TCG Star Wars: Unlimited Altered Naruto Kayou

I built this app because everywhere else, something was missing.

I collect across a dozen games myself — every feature of the app exists because my own collection demanded it, not because a roadmap did.

📷

Camera scan

Photograph a card, the app reads the printed set code — tuned per game against real physical cards, including tricky variants and misprint-prone fonts.

Each game has its own recognition logic, tuned against real physical cards. A bulk mode scans card after card, and a review screen with images lets you confirm everything before it lands in your collection. Forgot something while adding? No problem — you can always hop back to the review screen and fix it.

📊

Master-set tracking

"143 of 160 owned" — live completion for every set, with a missing-cards view so you always know what to hunt next.

Every set shows owned vs. total at a glance. Browse the complete set, filter down to just your missing cards, sort by name, date or rarity — and watch the completion fill up.

📖

Binders

Rebuild your real binder 1:1 in the app — 4, 9, 12 or 16 pockets per page, assign cards to a binder right while scanning, drag with your finger and flip pages like the real thing.

Same page size, same order as on your shelf. Drag cards between pockets with your finger, double-tap to shift a card and everything after it, insert empty pages anywhere — and new scans can go straight into the binder of your choice.

🃏

Decks & rules

Build decks from your collection — with automatic legality checks where the game's rules are wired in.

Build decks from your collection or plan beyond it. Where a game's rules are wired in, the app checks legality automatically — card limits, deck size — and in a detail view you swipe through your deck.

💶

Real market prices

Card and sealed-product values in EUR from Cardmarket — refreshed automatically, with manual matching for the tricky ones.

Prices refresh automatically from Cardmarket in EUR. If several listings exist for a card, you pick which one is yours; anything unmatched can be assigned by hand. You can also enter your own price per card — and you decide whether it counts into your totals or not.

✈️

Offline by design

Images of every card you own are stored on your device. Your collection stays visible in the basement, at a fair — or when a card source disappears from the internet.

The images of every card you own are stored on your device the moment you add them — and your self-hosted server keeps its own copies too. If a card database out there ever disappears, your collection keeps looking exactly the same.

👨‍👩‍👧

Multiple accounts

Track your own collection and your kid's side by side — separate collections, one app, one optional shared server.

Separate accounts on one device — each with its own completely independent collection, optionally PIN-protected. Perfect for tracking your kid's cards next to your own without ever mixing them up.

🛡️

No account

Your cards, your data! No account needed — your collections live only on your devices or your optional self-hosted server. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

No sign-up, no e-mail, no login against some cloud. The app works fully without an account from the very first launch — and if you want several devices in sync, your own server at home takes care of it. Nothing ever leaves your hands.

📤

Cardmarket-ready exports

Export any list — wants, missing cards, whole sets, duplicates — as a file in exactly the format Cardmarket expects, one card per line.

Wantslists, the missing cards of a set, whole sets, your duplicates — every export lands as a text file with one card per line, exactly the way Cardmarket's import expects it. Paste, import, done.

💾

Backups in your hand

Save everything you've entered as a single file right on your phone — and merge it back in anytime. Your data never needs anyone's cloud.

One tap saves everything you've entered — cards, binders, decks, wishlists, vault — as a single file on your phone. Importing only ever adds what's missing, so merging backups is always safe. An optional reminder keeps you on schedule.

✨

Holo tilt

Full-screen cards react to your device's gyroscope — and holo cards shimmer with a true foil-style rainbow gliding across the artwork.

Choose between four effects — Rainbow, Galaxy, Gold and Glitter — globally or per card, or let the app roll a style for each card. Simply there to digitally enjoy your collection.

📖

The handbook

The complete guide: once through the whole app, from your first scan to your own server — read it in the browser or save it as a PDF. Opens in a new tab.

Your server. Your data.

The optional companion server runs on your own hardware — a Raspberry Pi, a NAS, any Linux box. It syncs all your devices two-way and serves a full web interface for the big screen. My own collection lives on a server at my home, the exact same way — every new feature has to prove itself there in daily use before it ships.

There is no central cloud, and there never will be one. I don't run servers holding your collections — every instance belongs to the person using it. That's a promise built into the architecture, not a settings toggle.
